description: group_log/append.rs defines a local compute_entry_id() function that computes the SHA-256 of log_entry_canonical_bytes + signature. LogEntryId::from_entry() in types.rs does the same thing via entry_id_bytes(). Both call log_entry_canonical_bytes, extend with signature, and SHA-256 hash. One should call the other to eliminate the duplication.
title: core: compute_entry_id in append.rs duplicates LogEntryId::from_entry
